parsed.name: SRS830 锁相放大器
parsed.description: Stanford Research Systems 的 SRS830 锁相放大器，用于相敏检测与弱信号测量。该设备可设置参考频率、相位、输入耦合和采样参数，并支持 X、Y、R、θ 等量的缓冲采集、快照读取与自动调零/调相。
parsed.description_en: The SRS830 from Stanford Research Systems is a lock-in amplifier for phase-sensitive detection and weak-signal measurements. It supports control of reference frequency, phase, input coupling, and sampling parameters, and provides buffered acquisition, snapshot readout, and auto offset/auto phase functions for quantities such as X, Y, R, and theta.
